formula.body:
# Osmanthus Oolong Tea — 30mL EdP

## Character
A transparent tea-fruity composition built around osmanthus absolute — the apricot-leather-tea floral becomes the central axis of an osmanthus-oolong accord. Methyl Pamplemousse provides grapefruit-rhubarb tartness to the top, Hedione expands the tea-like transparency, and a clean musk base keeps the whole thing sheer and modern. Think Hermès Osmanthe Yunnan crossed with a Jo Malone transparency.

**Family**: Transparent Floral / Tea — light, modern, elusive

## Accords

| Accord | Role | Materials |
|--------|------|-----------|
| **Osmanthus-Tea core** | Character anchor | Osmanthus Absolute, Methyl Pamplemousse, Linalool, Petitgrain |
| **Citrus-grapefruit top** | Sparkling opening | Bergamot FCF, Cedrat FCF, Grapefruit FCF, Triplal (trace) |
| **Green transparency** | Aqueous freshness | Hedione HC, cis-3-Hexenol, Cyclamen Aldehyde, Floralozone |
| **Lactonic body** | Creamy mid | Gamma Decalactone, Apritone, Damascone Beta |
| **Clean musk base** | Sheer drydown | Zenolide, Romandolide, Macrolide, Iso E Super |
| **Fixative** | Invisible grip | Hexyl Salicylate, Benzyl Benzoate |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 2 | Cedrat FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 3 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 4 | Triplal | neat | 4 | 0.004 |
| 5 | Methyl Pamplemousse | 10% in TEC | 100 | 0.100 |
| 6 | Linalool | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 7 | Linalyl Acetate | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 8 | Petitgrain EO Paraguay | neat | 100 | 0.100 |
| 9 | Parmavert | neat | 30 | 0.030 |
| 10 | Dihydromyrcenol | neat | 30 | 0.030 |
| 11 | Pamzest | neat | 100 | 0.100 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 12 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 800 | 0.800 |
| 13 | Hedione HC | neat | 750 | 0.750 |
| 14 | Cyclamen Aldehyde | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 15 | Floralozone | 10% | 80 | 0.080 |
| 16 | Apritone | 10% | 150 | 0.150 |
| 17 | Damascone Beta | 10% | 50 | 0.050 |
| 18 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 40 | 0.040 |
| 19 | Beta Ionone | 1% in TEC | 100 | 0.100 |
| 20 | Freesia HDI | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 21 | Iso E Super | neat | 550 | 0.550 |
| 22 | Hexyl Salicylate | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 23 | Benzyl Benzoate | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 24 | Zenolide | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 25 | Romandolide | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 26 | Macrolide | 10% | 80 | 0.080 |
| 27 | Exaltolide | 10% | 60 | 0.060 |
| 28 | Vertofix | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 29 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 60 | 0.060 |
| 30 | Ebanol | neat | 50 | 0.050 |
| 31 | Cedramber | neat | 100 | 0.100 |

**Concentrate total**: 4,994 µL (16.6% of 30mL)
**Materials**: 31 (11 top, 9 heart, 11 base)

## Musk Chord (3-axis)

| Axis | Material | Dose | Function |
|------|----------|------|----------|
| Depth | Exaltolide + Macrolide | 60 + 80 (10%) | Skin-fatty intimacy |
| Projection | Romandolide | 150 neat | Clean diffusive outward projection |
| Character-echo | Zenolide | 120 neat | Citrusy-fresh musk — echoes grapefruit top |

## Fixative Gradient

| Layer | Material | Dose | VP |
|-------|----------|------|-----|
| Light | Hexyl Salicylate | 200 neat | 0.03 Pa — transparent green film |
| Inert | Benzyl Benzoate | 150 neat | 0.02 Pa — invisible anchor |

## Material Justification

- **Osmanthus Absolute (800 µL of 10% = 80 µL active)**: The tea-apricot core at 1.6% active — the lead voice in a transparent watercolor structure. Conservative dosing of the expensive absolute, compensated by Apritone and Gamma Decalactone for apricot character.
- **Parmavert (30 µL)**: Green violet-leaf freshness — replaces cis-3-Hexenol (not in inventory). Pairs with the ionones in the heart for a naturalistic green-floral bridge rather than the synthetic leaf of c3h.
- **Hedione HC (750 µL)**: Ellena-style radiance amplifier — creates the "transparent tea" airiness that lets osmanthus breathe. High-cis for maximum floral lift. Scorer-recommended +1% for luxury boost.
- **Zenolide (120 µL)**: Coldest musk — citrusy-fresh character-echo pairing with the grapefruit top. Chosen over Galaxolide (detergent) and Habanolide (too warm).
- **Macrolide (10%) + Exaltolide (10%)**: Gentle, barely-there musk depth — sheer skin-scent intimacy. Not meant to be smelled; meant to make the wearer smell like themselves but better.
- **Cedramber + Ebanol**: Clean woody duo — Cedramber bridges cedar-amber for tea-like warmth, Ebanol adds creamy sandalwood without Javanol's cold mineral edge. Clearwood removed (redundant with Vertofix+Cedramber earth-wood bridge).
- **No Benzyl Salicylate**: Deliberately excluded — too heavy and cosmetic for a transparent tea fragrance. Hexyl Salicylate alone provides invisible fixation.
- **No Galaxolide**: Excluded — even at trace it pulls toward synthetic laundry detergent, which would clash with the natural osmanthus-tea character.
